 Paris R3 preview and prediction: Ruud vs. Struff 
 November 4, 2026 
 Ricky 
 Match pick briefs 
 0 
 Andrew Patron/Delray Beach Open 
 This Rolex Paris Masters third-round match is a tough one to call, and it may come down to the speed of Court 1. We know the main court is playing like an ice rink and Court 1 is playing not as fast. But is it playing fast enough for Struff to beat Ruud? It’s certainly a possibility.
Regardless of the conditions, though, the bottom line is that Struff is playing the best tennis of his career at 36 years old. A quarterfinalist at Wimbledon this summer, Struff is coming off a runner-up performance in Brussels and a semifinal showing in Basel. Moreover, the German is 3-1 lifetime against Ruud in their head-to-head series.
 Pick: Struff in 3
